requirements.title: Dual-zone climate as standard and rear ventilation
requirements.statement: Driver and passenger temperatures shall be adjustable independently on every variant, the display shall not suggest zones that are not fitted, and rear passengers shall get air vents.

requirements.horizon_rationale: Software activation plus standard-content decision; rear vents in the life-cycle impulse.

requirements.statement: Ambient and display lighting shall not reflect in the side mirrors, side windows or windscreen at night at any brightness setting.

requirements.horizon_rationale: Light guide and default brightness changes.

requirements.title: Physical controls for climate and a rotary controller option
requirements.statement: Temperature, fan and seat or steering wheel heating shall have physical controls, and a rotary controller (or an equivalent haptic control) shall operate map zoom, lists and shortcuts so the driver does not have to aim at the touch screen while driving.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Touch screen operation is the largest complaint theme of the F70 in Europe (141 rows, 7.4 % of all complaints, 91 usability); 25 owners explicitly ask for the iDrive controller back and the operating concept adds 30 rows. Many describe touch-only climate control as unsafe.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Physical climate keys and a controller are a life-cycle-impulse change of the centre console.

requirements.title: Functions bought with the car stay included for the first owner

F70-0002.text: really solid build, lots of attention to detail. i only knock off one mark because there's no paper user manual.

F70-0010.text: its a really good car, definitely feels like an upgrade over my old f40 118i m sport. engine is strong and the mild hybrid gives a nice extra shove and helps with efficiency. it corners and rides very well and im getting better fuel economy than with the f40. some of the cabin materials feel a bit flimsier than before, not a big deal but i did notice. the new cabin layout looks great and all the digital stuff behaves properly. a few oddities though: the keyless entry/exit reacts way too easily, and sometimes the car systems seem to randomly reset, so auto hold ends up switched off in the menu even though i had it on. the speed warning feature is just irritating, even if i can switch it off each trip here in the uk.

F70-0015.text: the build quality seems not great; my seat has squeaks that i only noticed after turning my music off due to a damaged speaker. very frustrating to deal with both issues.

F70-0027.text: the car drives very well and has some lovely features, however i've had problems with both display modules going totally blank several times, always when the outside temperature is under zero degrees. the vehicle is currently with the local dealer for checks and repair.

F70-0047.text: the driving feel is good, but the software is terrible, the car acts like it has its own mind and starts doing things for no clear reason. very inconsistent behavior. i absolutely hate it!!

F70-0057.text: suspension feels overly firm, lots of passengers mention it.

F70-0061.text: it is frustrating that with each new bmw 1 series i own, fewer things seem to come as standard. putting spotify, satellite view and other functions behind a paid premium subscription is just poor.

F70-0086.text: i find the constant speed alert annoying, having to switch it off every single time i get in. at night the dash doesnt light up the vent position controls, and the lights at the end of the dash reflect in the side windows, getting in the way of the view in the door mirrors. the car really ought to have electric tailgate controls as standard.

F70-0088.text: i really like the car overall, but having only a full touch screen with no physical buttons is irritating and quite distracting. after just a few months the touch screen already feels slow. the buttons on the previous model were far better and much easier to operate.

F70-0128.text: far too much reliance on the bmnw app, and you can't really use the sat nav properly unless you register with the app.

F70-0134.text: i find the 7 speed dct gets slightly jerky at low speeds and when the car is cold. the climate controls on the display are annoying, my daughters older 1 series with real buttons was better. the passenger belt taps on the hard plastic when it is not being worn.

F70-0143.text: really happy with the car and the colour, but not impressed there isn't any handbook and also annoyed that premium digital costs extra.

F70-0144.text: i really like my car and have been a bmw fan since my first one a few years back. however there are little things that drag the score down, like the handbrake not engaging automatically when i put it in neutral, and having to pay extra for adaptive cruise control. there is also a buzzing coming from the driver door at highway speeds, which feels like something you would find on a cheaper car, not a bmw.

classifications.level3_raw: Vehicle equipment: not standard / too costly

F70-0155.text: the car drives nicely but sadly it does not meet our needs. the boot is smaller than we thought, and with the hybrid battery taking up space, which we did not realise, it is no use for trips with our dog. once the driving position is set, it has to be moved again so the smaller driver can get out of the vehicle. having almost everything run through the display screen instead of the steering wheel controls is distracting when driving and does not feel like a safe setup. apple car play is unreliable and seems to need tinkering every single time you use the car. there is no separate air conditioning for driver and passenger.

F70-0159.text: steering and handling are excellent. interior feels upmarket and the seats are very comfortable. economy is very strong yet performance is still good. there is, however, a notable delay on the throttle. the satnav is not as clear or informative as the one in the x2. the speedometer and rev counter are almost useless, hard to read because of the colours and graduated markings, even though the digital speed readout itself is easy to see. far too many settings overall and the menus are awkward to find your way through.

F70-0176.text: my car broke down and i couldnt get it started again, after roughly two months and about 3000kms on the clock. quite penalizing for someone investing in a new car for safety, expecting no nasty surprises!

F70-0196.text: the car itself is good, looks nice and drives well. the parking mirror doesn't work and has never worked - i've been in touch with the dealership over and over but sadly had no response. econmy is good as well.

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-0197.text: the boot space is pretty small, and after roughly 3 months it had to go back for a recall because of an issue with the rear seatbelts.

F70-0204.text: wish it came with front fog lights and leather seats as standard equipment.

F70-0206.text: so far it's been a really good car but i'm having a problem with a lot of condensation and damp on the driver's side when the weather is cold. right now it's just being kept an eye on.

F70-0233.text: so far i am really pleased with the car. what bothers me is that the reverse wing mirror no longer tilts down when reversing, which is a real nuisance. that should be standard and it feels like a step backwards. there is also a clicking sound from the gearbox area when i take my foot off the pedal, which is irritating, though i assume it is the hybrid cutting in.

classifications.level3_raw: Vehicle equipment: not standard / too costly

F70-0248.text: i dont like it as much as my previous vw vision, its just not as good. centre mirror gets in the way, door and boot both sound tinny when they close, big screen is distracting, and android auto isnt working (being dealt with with the garage).

F70-0266.text: i used to own a 118 shadow sport edition, and now have the 120m. the 120m is a pleasant car and quite economical, but i do have a few downsides when i compare it to my old one. the boot does not seem as big as before, and the new front design means dirt from the front wheels gets onto the sides of the car very easily, so it needs cleaning all the time. this was not an issue with my previous model.

F70-0268.text: my new 1 series comes much better equipped than the old one i had, so i am happy about that. i excuse the stiff suspension a bit but much less the bad setting of the door closures, above all the tailgate - you have to close it several times before the locks catch properly! i wonder how long they will last like that?

F70-0278.text: overall i'm satisfied with the car and it stacks up well against the different 3 series models i've owned before. i'm generally very pleased with the tech, but it still feels like it needs some fine tuning. three times the tailgate has suddenly closed by itself while either my wife or i were standing behind the car, and on one occasion the locking catch actually hit me on the head. there have also been occasions where the car has locked with me standing right next to it. another problem is with the warnings: i keep getting a message saying the rear right light cluster has failed, even though it is actually working. my bmw dealer is looking into this and i'm waiting for spare parts - all of this on a new car.

F70-0281.text: it is a comfortable place to sit, even if it is not exactly glamorous. driving is mostly good. the sunroof is a let-down though, i would have preferred a larger one. the fact that you push forward for reverse and pull back for drive feels completely crazy to me, i dont understand why anyone would set it up like that. the display isnt great either, everything is tiny, and i only just noticed i was almost out of fuel because it is so hard to see the fuel level. i have almost finished setting up the heating and cooling, but working out where the air actually goes is awkward and there are loads of little controls to fiddle with. i absolutely hate the parking and reversing assist, the car is constantly yelling at me, with margins that seem far too wide. it keeps making warning sounds for no reason i can figure out, and the car has already cut out twice and then would not go either backwards or forwards. i am now about to take it in to be checked.

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-0294.text: car feels very unpredictable, with various flaws and issues

F70-0311.text: engine feels a bit underpowered. the rotating wheel on the center console is gone, so poking at lots of apps on one screen feels awkward and unsafe. also missing any all-wheel drive options.

F70-0318.text: the suspension is far too hard for everyday use on british roads, it nearly shakes you to bits. i've ended up putting a bag of sand in the boot to try to cure this.

F70-0341.text: the boot has to be really slammed shut before it closes properly, which is pretty irritating..

F70-0358.text: i had to sort out taking the car back to bmw around 3 months after getting it because a rear light was faulty, after an urgent lighting system check recall popped up on my phone, and they replaced the whole light unit. that did not leave a great impression. i just hope that was a one-off bit of bad luck, so it still feels too early to judge it properly.

F70-0360.text: car only about 3 months old and already 2 immobilising breakdowns, totally unreliable

F70-0376.text: i am happy with the car overall but spotted a scratch on the rear seat, and the garage said because i had the car for about 8 weeks they wouldnt repair it. not great on a brand new car, especially as the back seat hasnt even been used.

F70-0384.text: the instrument display is inconsistent: sometimes it comes on straight away, other times i have to wait a few minutes for it to start up. i also don't like that the speed limit warning is switched on by default. the seat heating is too intense on the legs and should really concentrate more on the back. the heater in the footwell also feels a bit weak.

F70-0398.text: moved from a manual bmw to this automatic and it's very easy to drive. good mpg, great looking car, satnav works well and the camera system is excellent.

F70-0400.text: love how it drives, happy with the kit and mpg. only downside is having to pay extra for the full digital package, on a car of this quality and price it should really come as part of it

F70-0419.text: minor irritation with the parcel shelf, the width of the fitting really needs to be a bit longer. it is always a fiddle putting it back, as it keeps slipping from its place for being just slightly too narrow.

F70-0433.text: i'm not a fan of touch screens at all, and using them for heater controls is silly, especially when you might need to adjust them while driving. physical, tactile switches are far better. the steering wheel is too thick, not that comfortable, and definitely not as good as on my earlier bmws.

F70-0444.text: i basically like the car overall, but there are a few serious reservations. the ride is simply too firm even for a performance model, and although adaptive suspension is standard, you can't actually adjust it, which makes its usefulness very debatable. my biggest annoyance, though, is that everyday functions are effectively blocked because i don't own a smartphone and therefore don't use a bmw app. for example, the nearside mirror no longer dips when reversing and auto hold can't be left permanently on. when i first bought the car the salesperson configured these for me, but an ota update wiped those settings and i have no way of getting them back. so i now have a car that cost almost £50k, with features i can't use that were incredibly easy to set up on previous vehicles, which is really disappointing.

F70-0447.text: the car itself is very nice and generally feels worth the money. i really dislike the digital premium add on though, bmw putting basic features behind an extortionate pay wall isn't nice at all.

F70-0449.text: i ended up selling the car because the gearbox just wasnt like the bmw gearboxes ive had in any of my earlier bmws, it really was awful.

F70-0460.text: great car, but way too much complicated tech. brake discs went rusty after 3 months and were sorted out by an excellent dealership (hartons burford).

F70-0463.text: drivetrain problems have been going on since last autumn and the dealer doesn't seem bothered. they had it in once, said a software update sorted it, but it didn't. it's back with them again and they still don't know what's wrong.

F70-0476.text: a few of the electronic functions have just quit working on my car, and the worst one is the sat nav. it has dropped back to a very basic navigation system, and apparently i now need to pay extra for the better version.

F70-0481.text: really upset that it has been recalled for faulty seat belts, feels like my grandchildren have been put at risk.

F70-0488.text: overall the car looks great and the mild hybrid setup performs well. handling is generally very good, though it does hesitate when going over bigger cats eyes on the motorway. the app connection can be awkward and quite often fails entirely. the trip stats feature worked initially but then just stopped on 9th feb. the manual and the youtube guides do not give the right instructions for this new 120 model, so i have been forced to dig around myself to work out how to sort it, which is frustrating. visually, the radio station display is also a letdown.

F70-0503.text: i find the console display for navigation and driver info very good, and all the sensors do help with the occupant's safety. however, with my low mileage i don't really feel like i've had much of a wow factor. taking away the individual button has made the dashboard look cleaner but has also made it harder to alter settings, as you now have to work out which app to go into. some apps like 'spotify' that were on the previous car are now only there if you pay for digital premium, at extra cost. i still need to see if the 'navigation' information has been reduced since the digital premium trial finished. i think losing certain features has pushed the car more into the general mainstream hybrid market. i will definitely check other makers when it is time to swap cars.

F70-0617.text: driving it is excellent and the comfort is great, everything in the cabin feels like quality materials. i absolutely love this car. i only knocked off one point because the temperature controls are only reachable through the infotainment, which feels unsafe to use while actually driving.

F70-0723.text: happy with the design and overall look, and it is very enjoyable to drive as well as comfortable. it has enough power for daily use and is very economical.

F70-0733.text: first of all i was poorly sold this car, they pushed a basic version with options added on. within a couple of minutes of getting the keys the rearview mirror was hs, and when they fixed that they also did an update on the on-board computer. since that update, it basically doesnt work anymore. i was told i need to wait for the next update, and i still havent got it yet. the windows in the retro side that were changed dont go up on their own anymore, plus the car now uses about 1 liter more since that update. the automatic gearbox doesnt change gears quickly enough or properly, and the radio signal is weak. i am really disappointed, the after-sales is not up to standard and i do not have what i actually bought. the sales, the vehicle itself and the service are no longer at the old bmw level. if i could have just handed the key back, i would have. so what are you going to offer me? im ready to swap my car.

F70-0743.text: it's a beautiful car but i've now got noise coming from the brakes and there's already rust showing behind the tyres. i've only had it since december. i've been in touch with bmw and i'm still waiting for them to get back to me, so i'm a bit disappointed tbh.

F70-0745.text: much better than the last model and really nice to drive. the registration was needlessly complex and i have no use for the bmw app. i miss having the front extension on the sports seat. having to turn off the speed limit warning every single drive is irritating. glad the engine stop-start now works smoothly, i barely notice it cutting in and out.

F70-0748.text: not happy with the way this car holds the road even though it's front wheel drive. i've had wheel spin and the steering can feel a bit light while driving. acceleration should be more punchy, especially when overtaking. i do like the blind spot indicators in the mirrors and the interior looks smart. i don't like the airflow direction lever, it feels really cheap. overall i'm sadly disapointed with my purchase.

F70-0750.text: really enjoyable to drive. the cabin looks fantastic, though i do miss having the idrive central controller. it is a real shame it only comes with single zone aircon, which is extremely poor.

F70-0757.text: seats not comfy, audio system reacts slow. front arm rest storage is positioned too awkwardly to use.

F70-0764.text: the way the doors are shaped makes getting into the car awkward. i often end up bumping my head when climbing in. i am quite small, so i imagine someone taller would find it even harder to get in comfortably. the side wing mirrors also create a blind spot while driving. i am still familiarising myself with the car's features. if i had understood how tricky entry was before buying, i would have picked a different car. this part of the design really needs serious attention.

F70-0775.text: really great car and i like the whole concept of it. the one downside is that you dont actually get an owners manual.

F70-0787.text: i owned an f40 before this and with the extra power it drove really well. i am not happy that the air conditioning has to be adjusted on the screen, as trying to do that while driving feels potentially dangerous. at night the ambient lighting bounces off the driver side window and blocks part of the view in the door mirror, which to me is a possible safety issue. it makes me wonder if anyone from bmw has actually driven this model in the dark. i ended up switching the ambient lighting off entirely, which makes it seem pointless to have it on during the day anyway.

F70-0790.text: i asked the dealer about my heater synchronization but they had no answer. how to un-synchronise with connect drive they also do not know. is this an issue on all 120s? i want your feedback and am waiting for your reply.

F70-0794.text: several problems: 1. gearbox seems to slip when accelerating on roundabouts. 2. fuel consumption is far below the advertised mpg. 3. reversing / side front sensors are very slow to react, not sensitive, whatever company made them, they pick things up too late and are basically useless so i now have to look around manually. 4. reverse camera gets rain drops on it and sometimes you can't see anything. 5. there are more issues i've forgotten, these are just the ones i remember now.

F70-0801.text: it handles and drives really well, easily better than my last car, a mercedes amg. the downside is the build quality, with wind noise coming in around the door and wing mirror area. dip beam assist, curb side mirror tilt, wireless charging, all those extras you have to subscribe to are very disappointing, same with the fake adaptive driving sounds, theyre too artificial and just annoying. the car itself is very quiet and while i get trying to make it sound sporty, that natural turbo surge and release is more than enough for me.

F70-0809.text: it is an excellent car, yet i am a bit disappointed compared to my previous bmws. there are two main reasons - i really dislike the plastic vents and the plastic door handles, and i am not keen on having everything on the touch screen. getting rid of the rotary wheel feels like a step backwards.

F70-0827.text: from placing the order to getting the car, the delivery was far quicker than with my previous bmws, which was a nice surprise. my recent bmws have all been diesel, so finding the 1 series f70 only offered as petrol was rather disappointing. the car itself runs well and i am gradually getting used to operating system 9. i really do not like the lack of a paper handbook, as the built-in version is very hit and miss when trying to locate information, whereas the paper one had pictures and was much simpler to navigate. the missing physical auto hold button on the centre console is also strongly felt, especially after the last software update wiped the on screen setting, leaving you either holding the brake or messing with the selector switch.

F70-0880.text: fantastic car but extremely disappointed that after only about 5 weeks with a brand new model the whole dashboard crashed and needed a new part, meaning we were without our own car for roughly another 5 weeks! (the dealer in portstewart did give us a replacement car) but our main issue is with bmw for this kind of failure on a new car! it really knocks our confidence in bmw going forward and it was embarrassing having to tell people our car had to go back to the garage for repairs!! definitely not good for bmw. it is frustrating that bmw uk do not see this as a major problem and were hesitant to even admit it was disruptive for customers, so although the dealer gave us a hotel voucher it would have been considerate for bmw to at least acknowledge the fault and give an explanation!

F70-0901.text: boot space is smaller than i require, and a big drawback is that the heating/cooling system cannot be adjusted separately !!!

F70-0908.text: the upholstery does not seem as good as on my old 120 sport. there is also no storage for people in the back seats. the bottom corner of the driver's door especially needs attention, the sharp edge feels outright dangerous. i had a leg injury from the last car and told the dealer about it. sort it out!

F70-0913.text: we have been driving the bmw 120 for about three months now and it has been a pleasant experience, so we would recommend it to both family and friends.

F70-0951.text: the controls are way too complex to use. it is so overcomplicated my wife refuses to ever drive it, and it is more than i feel comfortable dealing with. because of that this will be the last bmw i buy.

F70-0955.text: as a small car it is excellent overall. plenty of space, comfortable and quick off the mark, with very smooth pull through the gears and really strong grip and cornering behaviour. the keyless boot release can be a bit unreliable. the digital key setup can also be frustrating at times: with my iphone and apple watch the car unlocks as i walk up, but if i open the boot to load it, by the time i've shut it and gone round to the driver door it has locked again and i need to stand for a moment until it opens. the mirrors do not always fold when locking, and the instrument cluster sometimes drops my personal layout. aside from those small digital issues, everything else is perfect.

F70-0988.text: bmw are just greedy. asking £200 to activate automatic high and low beam is ridiculous. and then charging for a paper hand book on top of that, you are really taking the mickey. no surprise european car sales are plummeting.

F70-0994.text: it is a lovely car overall but i am disappointed with the climate control setup. i cannot locate any sync off button, so the driver and passenger temperature settings are always locked together. you cannot run them at different temperatures, which seems odd for a car packed with technology. i mentioned this to the dealership where i purchased the car over 2 months ago and still have not heard anything back.

F70-0995.text: ever since i took ownership all i've had is hassle getting the original fault sorted, with the car repeatedly going in and out of the workshop. i've been without it on and off since i got it in june and the issue still isn't resolved.

F70-1049.text: really comfy car with great handling. the old bmw signature headlights are gone, took a bit to get used to the new look but its growing on me. overall im happy with it.

F70-1052.text: i only managed to use the car for the first couple of weeks, then i hit a pothole that somehow bent the front suspension (strut/hub) even though the tyre didnt blow. havent been able to use it since, its stuck at the body shop waiting on a part, with some bits on back order, which i find crazy for such a new car to have no parts. i really dont get how a pothole that didnt even pop the tyre could bend several suspension parts (poor design or quality).

F70-1070.text: i have downsized to this small car and really like the x drive, with the 2 litre engine giving enough power for everyday use. the whole 'apps' setup feels clumsy and can distract when you just want to tweak something simple like the seat heating or heated steering wheel. after a software update some settings went back to factory, which was annoying as i only noticed at night when the instrument brightness had changed. this is a car, not a mobile phone. the boot space is badly cut down by the 'hybrid lite' batteries. over 30+ years i have had 10 new bmws and this is the first one that has no anchor points in the boot, which is particularly irritating when stuff slides around. overall still a good little car.

F70-1080.text: the car is comfortable and still fun to drive, with light controls, decent performance and good economy, and it clearly shows bmw build quality. i only marked it down from a '10' because the instruments are poor and much harder to read than on my older 325 coupe, which is vastly better laid out and more ergonomic. traditional analogue gauges are far easier to glance at without looking away from the road. the lack of a proper printed handbook also makes figuring out the complicated touch screen more difficult. the on-screen 'keyboard' for entering satnav addresses is definitely better, but the male navigation voice is less clear than the female one on my previous 118. the voice-controlled satnav is a complete waste for us, it simply will not work for either me or my wife.

F70-1082.text: annoying that the start/stop override can only be changed in the infotainment now. every trip i have to switch off lane departure and the speed limit warning again, really spoils it. the thin vents make the ventilation loud with wind noise. audio system not working with carplay is also very irritating.

F70-1251.text: this is the 6th bmw i have owned, a mix of new and used, and i've liked every single one of them. i feel this particular model is the best yet, it is a pleasure to drive. i was hesitant about going for an automatic at first, but i wanted this model so i went ahead, and i have absolutely no regrets. it comes with all the technology i realistically need, even though i know there are extra options available beyond what i have. the car responds quickly when you ask it to, is comfortable, and the interior layout is very well thought out. the boot is big enough to carry my band gear without issues. i picked the midnight thunder paint and friends and family often comment on how distinctive it looks. the only downside was one time when the software hadn't updated properly and i had to carefully coax the car back home, luckily i was close by and an engineer sorted it out. now i always keep an eye on the app for that.

F70-1311.text: i'm very pleased with my new car overall. it fits what i need and comes with lots of extra features. the performance is excellent and i really like the interior and all the functions. my favourite bits are the heated seats, the heated steering wheel, the different drive modes and being able to personalise things like the ambient lighting. the parking camera works really well, and there were plenty of choices when buying it new. on the downside, i would have rated it even higher. i paid extra to have an electric boot fitted. the car has only done around 500 miles, and i don't think i'd actually used the electric boot up to that point. i walked up to the car, pressed the boot open button on the key, and there was nothing around me, then i heard a loud bang. when i checked, the parcel shelf clearly hadn't been fitted properly, had come loose while driving, got wedged, and the auto boot mechanism snapped the clips. i took it back to the dealer, but they couldn't assist, only telling me it would be £280 to get a new parcel shelf. #really

F70-1652.text: the controls are far too complicated and techy. the handling itself is very good. double locking feels over the top. i need a bean bag on the driver side of the dash to stop light reflecting in the interior mirror.

F70-1662.text: really nice car, drives well, comfortable and economical. has some handy features and feels like a bigger, more refined car packed into a smaller body.

F70-1665.text: too expensive, after the first few months you have to pay extra for basic stuff. performance is nothing to shout about. heating controls are fiddly, same with the computer systm. siri feels pointless, more often than not it doesnt pick up what you say properly. ive had a lot of bmws over the years and this one is the worst yet.

F70-1686.text: gears feel a little sluggish when shifting up, and there is a noticeable lag from pressing the accelerator to actually pulling away from a standstill.

F70-1693.text: overall i am pleased with the car, but i really do not like that the new operating system is completely touchscreen. i very much miss having the turnwheel on the centre console. also unhappy that you cannot attach two keys to a single profile. because of this setup, i would not purchase another one.

F70-1708.text: really happy with how comfortable it is to drive. bit disappointed though, the drivers rear indicator/light/brake keeps showing a fault, dealer checked it over and says they cant find anything wrong. now just hanging on for a bmw software update.

F70-1714.text: after 4 trips back to the service centre about the climate control, i eventually found out that being able to set passenger and driver temperatures separately is actually an optional extra. the service centre hadn't realised this, so i didn't either. it would have been good to know, especially as my last bmw had that as standard. paying £9.99 a month for connecteddrive also feels like a bit of a con. as you can tell, i'm not very impressed.

classifications.level2_raw: BMW ConnectedDrive upgrades/ MINI CONNECTED upgrades

F70-1728.text: i had to take my bmw back on two separate occasions because of a faulty sensor. the service i received was really good, and i am hoping the problem is now sorted. hopefully i can just enjoy driving it for the next few years and then look to upgrade to another bmw.

F70-1767.text: i really like how my car looks, but the idrive/entertainment setup is a disappointment. had lots of problems with the screen cutting out and needing to be re-sett.

F70-1788.text: nice car but the boot is small, and its model is a bit low

F70-1790.text: the car is fine, but the software feels needlessly complicated. having no handbook, and the continued delay in receiving one, is not good.

F70-1792.text: car was new in april 2025. on july 22nd 2025 it was booked into hillside bmw for faults to be checked. not as pleased as i expected, thought bmw would be reliable.

F70-1801.text: fantastic little drivers car, handles brilliantly. can cruise quiet and refined, or turn into a slapped cheetah when you want. cabin finish is excellent.

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-1821.text: i'm happy with pretty much every aspect of the car. the only downside is that the boot is quite small.

F70-1827.text: driving it is excellent, but it doesn't feel very customer friendly. i think buyers should get clearer instructions on how the apps and controls are supposed to work.

F70-1833.text: i have already had to return the car to the dealer three times because it keeps dropping its speech function. when i collected it initially, it was missing bmw assist and sat nav and it would not connect to my phone at all. it took two separate visits before those things were finally sorted. afterwards the voice function for the sat nav vanished again. sometimes the text messages show on the touch screen, sometimes they do not. the way the car drives is excellent, but the problems above really spoil it. this is my 4th 1 series and it may end up being my last.

F70-1841.text: persistent software trouble with the rear lights, leading to nonstop error warnings.

F70-1846.text: generally the car is good, but in my view the electronic dash totally spoils it. my wife and i have done around 3800 miles since buying it and we have decided that trying to change anything hidden in the dash while on the move is just too dangerous, because of how long your eyes are off the road. so if we are together the passenger does the adjustments, and if alone we pull over to change things. i feel this system is many times more complex than my iphone, and it is illegal to use an iphone while driving. what is wrong with simple knobs, switches and dials? i also dread to think what it will cost to replace the dash when it eventually fails.

F70-1848.text: i had the f40 before and this one feels a big upgrade in how it rides, overall quality and performance. outside still looks like the premium level you expect, and the revised lights are definitely an improvement over the old model. the cabin is excellent, with the vinyl replacing leather being a really good touch as it is simple to keep clean and look after. lots of changes make it fantastic to drive, and the newer tech like reverse assist, park assist plus and the rear camera really help the experience. the infotainment display and driver binnacle are both excellent and can be set up easily, and the operating system works very well. i do really miss the auto dipping near side mirror though, it feels like a penny pinching move given how useful it was. and still no usb ports in the back!!!!

F70-1866.text: apple car play often fails to hook up first time and the boot rack feels cheap and snaps easily

F70-1873.text: nice compact hatchback, comfortable and good value. i like being behind the wheel. only drawback is the climate system isn't split for driver and passenger sides.

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-1875.text: this is our 4th bmw and we're still pleased. the new tech takes a while to get used to but we're slowly getting there. really miss having a basic printed manual though. the map display isn't as clear as in our old 2015 118d, and the idrive knob gave more definite and maybe safer control than all the swiping. we also miss one-touch access to trip data like fuel, time and mileage, as the screen apps can't really be used while driving. the speed warning needs to be right at the top of the screen to see it easily. there's wind noise around the screen pillars and the tyres are noisy on many surfaces. pull-away from standstill hesitates unless you use firm throttle. still, it drives well and the quality feels way above other brands.

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-1889.text: owned the car 4 months now. after about 2 months it had to go back to the dealer to sort a driver assistant error message. since then the car keeps locking itself again after i open it with the remote key. 2 days ago it locked with me inside, set off the alarm sensor and disabled the vehicle, so i had to call bmw assistance.

classifications.level2_raw: Driver assistance, automated driving, overall technology

F70-1893.text: its a nice car but as a shorter person my visability isnt great and i cant get the seat high enough without the seatbelt digging into my neck. i feel like i picked the wrong car for me.

F70-1904.text: great car to drive. spoiled a bit by the cost-cutting single climate controls. dual-zone air should really be standard on an m model.

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-1906.text: it is enjoyable to drive, but as with the m135i, i feel it has lost some of the sharp edge that made the m140i such a fantastic car. a 4 cylinder engine just does not quite deliver what i expect from a super-hot hatch. apart from that, the car is well equipped.

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-1911.text: the car feels very basic. i do not think it is right to have to pay a subscription for the inboard services.

F70-1919.text: gives a fantastic drive and there are plenty of good optional extras. however, our car is only 3 months old and we already had 2 issues. we really hope nothing else goes wrong or our rating would drop a lot.

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-1921.text: great car, i really love it. next one will probably have to be electric so i cant give it a 10. the speed safety warning is very irritating, having to switch it off every time is a pain. i have hit the handbrake button a couple of times instead of the safety button, so i think they sit too close together. still a great car.

F70-1923.text: compared with my previous 118, the new use of icons makes the instruments feel overly complicated. i'm really unhappy the head-up display has gone. it was also a struggle to get a proper handbook, and without that the controls are hard to figure out. there is no guidance on how to use the satnav, and nothing available online either. the lack of decent supporting information spoils what is otherwise an excellent car. dropping the proper spare wheel option was a bad decision.

F70-1924.text: i am really very disappointed with this new model! the personal assistant and the navigation are neither efficient nor reliable, expecially when i compare them to my previous s1, which i just cannot understand. on top of that, i cannot separate the driver and passenger temperatures, and i also cannot change the voice of the ap!!

F70-1928.text: overall i'm very happy with the car. its great to drive and it definately feels like a premium vehicle. the only downside is a rattle in the passenger door, something loose behind the door card that got missed during qc.

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-1947.text: i'm very happy with the car itself and would have scored it a 10, but i've already had 2 serious faults that meant going back to the garage multiple times, ending up with a replacement gearbox and a new engine coolant pipe. for a brand new car that has been really disappointing.

F70-1966.text: do not like the dashboard lights, they bounce off into the wing mirror at night and make the mirrors basically unusable. also do not like that i have to switch the lane controls on every single time i start up. boot would be better if it just opened when you unlock with the key fob.

F70-1967.text: with engine breaking it feels like the brakes are coming on, instead of letting the car just coast.

F70-1978.text: build quality feels let down, the doors dont seem very solid. getting into and out of the car is awkward. i kind of wish we had kept our old x1.

F70-1980.text: everything is fine and packed with tech, but i still think this version should at least come with an electric boot opener.

F70-1985.text: i'm very happy with the car overall. the only minor letdown is the air conditioning, it's pretty loud and doesn't cool nearly as well as our old 420i. even our mini has stronger ac than this 120.

F70-1997.text: really happy with the car overall, it drives lovely and the performance feels great. the suspension though is far from good, its so stiff over every bump that every passenger has commented on it.

F70-1999.text: the purchase experience went well, but everyday use of the car is spoiled by the software. it is extremely frustrating having to keep resetting passwords, syncing, and re-saving seat and personal preferences over and over again.

F70-2008.text: very good looking car and comfortable to sit in. the only real negative so far is the poor grip when the weather is bad, the front wheels tend to spin much too easily.

F70-2009.text: illumination from the dashboard reflects onto the inside glass in front of the driver by the wing mirrors

F70-2031.text: not a fan of the fake engine sound. with a sports model, i'd have expected less heavy noise cancelling so you get a more natural sporty tone.

F70-2032.text: very enjoyable car to drive, but the fuel economy is noticeably poorer than the other bmws i've owned before. for a top-of-the-range model i was quite surprised it doesn't have the mirrors tilting down in reverse, and that i was told this feature is a paid extra, really?

classifications.level2_raw: Drive, driving dynamics and chassis, overall technology

F70-2065.text: i really like this car overall, but there are definitely ups and downs.   pros: the way it drives in general; the new style seats are really comfy; and you can feel that classic bmw engineering in every part of this m sport 1 series.    cons: the active-lane-keeping-assistant feels dangerous on narrow roads and on uk cars you can't permanently switch it off. all the tech being buried in the screen menus and not just on a simple button is frustrating; and the turning circle is way bigger than my old mercedes so it needs a lot more steering work.

classifications.level2_raw: Driver assistance, automated driving, overall technology

F70-2110.text: overall i'm happy with the car, but it does have some electronic issues, like alerts that don't seem justified and occasional temporary loss of on-board data.

F70-2118.text: there are 2 issues with the car that the workshop has failed to sort out even after 2 visits. i then sent them 3 emails asking for a complaint to be raised and they have just ignored me. both the vehicle and the service fall below the standard i expect from bmw

F70-2119.text: boot is too cramped and there are no usb sockets for rear passengers

F70-2120.text: overall very happy with the 120 m sport, with sharp performance and handling, excellent build quality, and top-class interior materials and finish. disappointed that the rotary controller has been removed, as the touchscreen is distracting to operate when driving. suspension feels very firm for a family car, and there is some disappointment with how much road noise comes through, especially on the motorway.

# Requirement list, F70 EU

18 requirements. Priority scores follow in Phase 5.

## REQ-F70-EU-DA-01 – Assistance systems that help instead of irritating

*driver_assistance · H1 · markets EU · evidence B · recommended · status proposed (v1)*

Speed-limit warning and lane assistance shall be switchable off with one press per drive, and the emergency brake shall not intervene without a real obstacle.

**Why:** Driver assistance draws 24 rows with 17 defects (unexpected braking) and the speed-limit assistant 16 rows (14 usability) because it must be switched off after every start.
**Horizon:** Software within the limits of EU safety regulation.

| Market | Metric | Target | Method | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EU | Presses to switch off speed-limit warning and lane assistance | 1 (one shortcut for both) | Function test | assumption |
| EU | Unjustified emergency brake interventions reported | 0 in the next feedback wave | Customer feedback | assumption |

**Findings:** `FND-F70-EU-VOC-driver_assistance_automated_driving_overall_tech` (primary); `FND-F70-EU-VOC-speed_limit_assistant` (supporting)
**Uncertainties:** EU General Safety Regulation requires these systems to be active at every start; only the switch-off effort can change.
**Effort:** 0.37 % of a new vehicle generation (adapt, P5 to P95 0.17 to 0.65, layer K1), effort model 789fcb7624b8, assumptions not calibrated

## REQ-F70-EU-DD-01 – Comfortable ride on poor road surfaces

*driving_dynamics · H1 · markets EU · evidence B · recommended · status proposed (v1)*

Non-M variants shall offer a comfort-oriented suspension that absorbs sharp bumps on poor European roads without losing the car's sporty handling.

**Why:** Suspension and damping draw 41 complaint rows (2.2 %, 12 wishes for a softer ride) and the study scores ride comfort at 9.20 vs peer 9.73; adaptive suspension is standard only on the M135.
**Horizon:** Damper tuning and an adaptive-suspension option fit the life-cycle impulse.

| Market | Metric | Target | Method | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EU | Study ride comfort (1-10) | >= 9.6 (today 9.20, peer 9.73) | Next EU customer study wave | evidence |
| EU | Adaptive suspension | Available as option on all variants | Offer check | assumption |

**Findings:** `FND-F70-EU-VOC-cushioning_damping_vehicle` (primary); `FND-F70-EU-MET-cn_eu_2025-ride_comfort` (supporting); `FND-F70-EU-EQ-cushioning_damping_vehicle` (context)
**Effort:** 2.07 % of a new vehicle generation (adapt, P5 to P95 0.97 to 3.51, layer K1), effort model 789fcb7624b8, assumptions not calibrated

## REQ-F70-EU-DD-02 – Keep the sporty handling and the fuel economy in the next generation

*driving_dynamics · H2 · markets EU · evidence B · recommended · status proposed (v1)*

The successor shall keep the agile handling and the fuel economy that customers praise today.

**Why:** Sportiness (9.34 vs peer 7.30) and fuel economy (9.30 vs 7.56) are the strongest study advantages; driving dynamics collects 415 likes. Strengths to protect.
**Horizon:** Applies to the successor generation.

| Market | Metric | Target | Method | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EU | Study sportiness and fuel economy (1-10) | >= 9.0 each | Customer study of the successor | evidence |

**Findings:** `FND-F70-EU-MET-STRENGTH-cn_eu_2025-sportiness` (primary); `FND-F70-EU-MET-STRENGTH-cn_eu_2025-fuel_economy` (primary); `FND-F70-EU-VOC-STRENGTH-drive_driving_dynamics_and_chassis_overall_techn` (supporting)

## REQ-F70-EU-EX-01 – Reliable exterior lights and helpful door mirrors

*exterior_design · H1 · markets EU · evidence B · recommended · status proposed (v1)*

Exterior lights shall work without fault messages; door mirrors shall tilt down on the kerb side when reversing and fold automatically when locking.

**Why:** Exterior lighting draws 26 rows with 19 defects (failed or falsely reported lamps); door mirrors 28 rows with 11 wishes for kerb tilt and auto-fold that previous 1 Series had.
**Horizon:** Production quality and software functions.

| Market | Metric | Target | Method | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EU | Lighting defect rows | <= 5 per 6 months (today 19) | Customer feedback | assumption |
| EU | Kerb-side mirror tilt in reverse | Standard on all variants | Offer check | assumption |

**Findings:** `FND-F70-EU-VOC-exterior_lighting` (primary); `FND-F70-EU-VOC-exterior_rearview_mirror` (primary)
**Effort:** 1.11 % of a new vehicle generation (adapt, P5 to P95 0.54 to 1.97, layer K1), effort model 789fcb7624b8, assumptions not calibrated

## REQ-F70-EU-EX-02 – Quiet tyres and wheels that are easy to clean
